summary: Missing hiker near Michigan Ditch trail by Cameron Pass; party called from a call box, male had hiked up a trail to take pictures and had not returned. LCSAR, dogs, trackers, and Jackson County were mobilizing when the group returned to the Trading Post and reported the subject had come back; no further response needed.
location: Michigan Ditch trail, near Cameron Pass
notes: Filed Larimer per Cameron Pass DB precedent (ids 2547, 2480); Jackson County assisted from its side.
